get.description:
⚠️ The user must be logged in ⚠️

Reads the user's account data

The image is a HTTP path to the user's profile picture using the same host:port as the API

put.description:
⚠️ The user must be logged in ⚠️

Updates the user's account

The image must be base64 encoded and must contain the file type in the header (ex: data:image/png;base64,...)

All fields are optionals, if a field is empty or not provided, it will not be updated

parameters.description: New arguments to be set in the user
parameters.name: id

delete.description:
⚠️ The user must be logged in ⚠️

Deletes the user's account from database, the user will also be logged out
Careful, there is no turn back or check, once called, this route will delete the user no matter what
It also deletes all content related to the user

parameters.description: Email + Password combination of the corresponding user
parameters.name: creds

post.description:
Disconnection of the user
The token in the Cookies will be deleted after this route has been called

Connection of a new user to a new account
Token will be set in cookies if the username or email is not already taken

The image must be base64 encoded and must contain the file type in the header (ex: data:image/png;base64,...)
